elements.name: finasteride-statement
elements.html:
Please confirm that you've read and understood the following:

It's important to be aware that if you experience any side effects, please stop taking the treatments and speak to your doctor as soon as possible. Finasteride can very rarely cause changes in mood, including depression, or changes in sexual function. These effects usually resolve after stopping treatment, and your doctor can explore other options to support your hair loss goals. Read more



You must stop using Finasteride-containing products at least 3 months prior to trying for a baby/conception, and must not continue with using Finasteride-containing products unless at least 3-months post-conception. Further information can be found here: https://mothertobaby.org/fact-sheets/finasteride/



Sons are license holders and hold Marketing Authorisation for Finasteride 1mg and 5% Minoxidil solution. Other treatment plans can contain different preparations of medications such as Minoxidil and Finasteride which are off-license usage or unlicensed 'specials' which are produced by a specials manufacturer.

elements.html: Sons products are formulated for those born male and we do not currently provide treatment for those who were born female. Whilst some of these treatments may be suitable for those born female, we would recommend a face to face consultation with a hair loss specialist or GP to ensure the most appropriate treatment options.
